title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国呼吁结束英语核心地位引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers, and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.
summary.zh: 在中国学校降低英语地位的呼吁正在引发关于其对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The debate in China about the role of English in education touches on how societies navigate the explosion of knowledge and global communication. As Professor Tang Jiafeng questions English's dominance, it mirrors the broader challenge of discerning which knowledge serves us best in an era of unprecedented information growth, as described in Daniel 12:4:...
reflection.zh: 在中国关于英语教育作用的辩论，触及了社会如何应对知识的爆炸式增长和全球交流。正如唐嘉风教授质疑英语的主导地位，这也反映了一个更广泛的挑战：在一个信息空前增长的时代，辨别哪些知识最能服务于我们。正如但以理书12:4所描述的：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Why a vacuum at the top could drive Australia's housing market down
title.zh: 为什么高层真空可能导致澳大利亚房地产市场下跌

summary.en: Experts warn that a downturn at the top of the market is beginning to spread to lower-priced real estate across Australia. Data shows that upper-quartile house prices in Sydney and Melbourne have fallen at more than double the rate of entry-level homes, with some high-end properties selling for millions less than...
summary.zh: 专家警告称，高端市场的低迷正开始蔓延到澳大利亚全国范围内的低价房地产。数据显示，悉尼和墨尔本的最高四分之一房价下跌速度是入门级住房的两倍多，一些高端房产的售价比峰值损失了数百万澳元。

body.en:
Across Australia's capital cities, prices in the upper end of the property market are dropping rapidly, with experts warning it could indicate where the rest of the sector is headed.

Recent data from property analytics firm Cotality reveals that upper-quartile house prices — those in the top 25 per cent — have fallen at more than double the rate of entry-level ones in Sydney and Melbourne.

High-end homes in both cities have seen declines of more than 10 per cent in value from their peak. By contrast, those in the lower quartile have seen declines of just 3.9 to 5.4 per cent.

In Sydney, a mansion in Balmain East sold for an extraordinary $7 million loss this month — after selling for almost $20 million in 2022, it was bought for $12.8 million.

Cotality executive research director Tim Lawless told SBS News that the top end of the housing market historically moves first in a property cycle. While the sector overall peaked in March, the upper end peaked in October/November last year .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As the Reserve Bank's rate hikes filter through, Lawless said buyers are being hit with a severe credit crunch as borrowing rates hover around 9.5 per cent, severely weakening purchasing power.

A household on a median income is now spending more than 50 per cent of its pre-tax income to serve a median-priced mortgage. As a result, those who might have previously looked in the middle-to-upper bracket are being pushed toward cheaper stock.

"Mainstream demand is getting deflected towards lower price points where buyers can actually demonstrate an ability to service the loan," Lawless explained.

Taken together, first home buyers, investors, and price-sensitive mid-tier individuals are all now competing for limited stock, which has left high-end listings exposed.

The impact of the demand vacuum at the top has been visible on the ground for some time, with vendor discounting widening while time-on-the-market has lengthened.

Director and chief auctioneer at New South Wales independent AuctionWorks noted that the sharpest initial repricing has likely passed, however wealthy buyers are in no rush to step back in.

"The top end of the market has been the most affected, with significant price adjustments occurring in recent months," Davidson told SBS News.

"However, it appears that whilst we may not yet have seen the bottom of the market, the price reductions have certainly slowed."

Davidson added that buyers are beginning to recognise value, but a lack of urgency remains the defining feature of higher-end auctions at present.

title.en: A 'child bride' divorced at 20: Meet Australia's youngest divorcees
title.zh: 20岁离异：认识澳大利亚最年轻的离婚者

summary.en: This article introduces young Australians who married and divorced early, noting the similar reasons behind their decisions. It features Natalie Hancock, who grew up in a Pentecostal church in Sydney and married at 19 after meeting her husband through church connections, only to later divorce.
summary.zh: 本文介绍了澳大利亚年轻的离婚者，她们早婚早离，原因惊人地相似。其中一位是娜塔莉·汉考克（Natalie Hancock），她在悉尼的五旬节派教会中长大，19岁结婚，不久后离婚。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Natalie Hancock was told her entire life that the most important thing a young woman could do was get married.

She grew up in Sydney's Hills District, immersed in her local Pentecostal church, where, by her late teens, her biggest romantic prospect was a boy from church who told her that God had chosen him as an "ordained messenger" and came bearing a message for her: that she should marry him.

But at 19 — while expanding her world at a working holiday program in the UK she soon discovered was something of a scam — Natalie met the man who would become her husband within a year.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They met while working at a pub together: He was the chef and 10 years her senior. Natalie recalls he'd recently arrived from Hungary and barely spoke a word of English, but she was smitten.

"Having grown up firmly rooted in the church, my experience with men — and relationships in general — was pretty stunted."

"I was thrilled — not because I knew it was a good, or even safe, decision; but because I had grown up in a world where getting married was one of, if not the most important thing you could do as a young woman," she says.

Less than a year later, the pair separated, joining the tens of thousands of young Australians who divorce each year.

The latest annual figures from the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) show more married couples divorced in 2025 than the year before: 49,148 divorces were granted — an increase of 4.1 per cent — pushing the national divorce rate to 2.2 per 1,000 people, up from 2.1 in 2024.

The median age at divorce has stayed relatively steady in recent years and sits at 47.3 for men and 44.4 for women.

But dig a little deeper into the data and you'll find a small, easy-to-miss subset: the people who married and divorced young.

In 2025, 775 women aged 16-19 and 11,868 women aged 20-24 got married, compared with 296 and 7,789 men in the same age brackets.

That same year, 458 women aged 16-24 got divorced — an equivalent divorce rate of 0.3 per 1,000 people. Only 170 men in the same age bracket divorced, at a rate of 0.1 per 1,000 people.

It's a narrow slice of the population, but many within it have similar stories to share.

Brenda, whose name has been changed for privacy reasons, was pressured by her family to marry young at the age of 23. Looking back, the now 35-year-old says this stemmed largely from her mixed Lebanese and Greek Catholic background.

"There was an underlying pressure in terms of family, culture, religion and timing. I come from...

reflection.en: The story of Natalie Hancock, married at 19 and divorced by 20, touches on the fragility of early unions often influenced by community expectations. Malachi 2:16 speaks of Yahweh hating divorce and the breaking of faith, a principle that resonates with the pain and brokenness evident in such young lives marked by marital dissolution.
reflection.zh: 娜塔莉·汉考克19岁结婚，20岁离婚的故事，触及了在社群期望影响下早期婚姻的脆弱性。玛拉基书2章16节提到雅伟憎恨离婚和背弃婚约，这原则与如此年轻生命中显现的婚姻破裂的痛苦和破碎产生了共鸣。

verse.textEn: 'The man who hates and divorces his wife,' says Yahweh, 'does violence to the one he should protect.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「休妻的事，是我所恨恶的。」

title.en: As Japan’s yen peaks, is the era of budget-friendly trips coming to an end for Australian travellers?

summary.en: The Japanese yen has reached its highest level against the US and Australian dollars in six months. This shift in currency value, following interventions by Tokyo and Washington to support the yen, signals a potential end to the era of budget-friendly travel to Japan for Australian tourists.
summary.zh: 日元兑美元和澳元汇率已达到六个月来的最高点。在东京和华盛顿干预以支撑日元后，这一货币价值的转变，预示着澳大利亚游客前往日本经济实惠旅行时代可能即将结束。

body.en: The currency has now reached its highest level against the US and Australian dollars in six months Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast In the unpredictable world of global currency markets, there has been one safe bet: that the Japanese yen would continue its relentless decline. In recent weeks, that trade has started to unravel after Tokyo and Washington intervened to support the longsuffering Japanese currency. Continue reading...
body.zh: 日元兑美元和澳元现已达到六个月来的最高水平 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 在不可预测的全球货币市场世界中，有一个安全的赌注：日元将继续其无情的下跌。最近几周，在东京和华盛顿出手干预以支持长期受苦的日元之后，这种贸易开始瓦解。继续阅读...

reflection.en: For years, a strong dollar made Japan an accessible destination for many Australian travelers. Now, as the yen strengthens, the financial landscape shifts, reminding us of the constant flux in economic fortunes. This change underscores the principle that financial advantage can be fleeting, and those who rely on favorable exchange rates may find their plans...
reflection.zh: 多年来，强势美元使日本成为许多澳大利亚游客可负担的目的地。如今，随着日元走强，经济格局发生变化，提醒我们经济财富的不断变动。这一变化凸显了这样一个原则：经济优势可能转瞬即逝，那些依赖有利汇率的人可能会发现他们的计划被打乱了。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

title.en: Crossbench MPs launch push to stop Australian military exports being used in human rights breaches
title.zh: 跨党派议员发起推动，阻止澳大利亚军事出口被用于侵犯人权

summary.en: Crossbench MPs are introducing 'red lines' legislation to prevent Australian defence equipment and technology from being used in ways that breach international human rights obligations. This bill specifically targets potential misuse by the Israeli military, including parts for F-35 fighter jets, and aims to compel...
summary.zh: 跨党派议员正在引入“红线”立法，以防止澳大利亚的国防设备和技术被用于侵犯国际人权义务。该法案特别针对以色列军队可能存在的滥用行为，包括F-35战斗机的零部件，并旨在迫使政府履行其国际承诺。

body.en: ‘Red lines’ legislation would forbid defence equipment technology or services being used, includes parts for F-35 fighter jets Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Crossbench MPs including David Pocock and Sophie Scamps will put pressure on the Albanese government to ban Australian goods from being used by the Israeli military – including for F-35 fighter jets – by introducing a bill designed to force it to adhere to international obligations. The group’s “red lines” legislation, to be presented on Monday, would outlaw defence equipment, technology or services being used where they could breach Australia’s international human rights obligations. Continue reading...
body.zh: “红线”立法将禁止使用国防设备技术或服务，包括用于 F-35 战斗机的零部件 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 包括 ​​David Pocock 和 Sophie Scamps 在内的跨议员议员将向阿尔巴尼亚政府施压，禁止以色列军方使用澳大利亚产品，包括用于 F-35 战斗机的零部件，并提出一项旨在迫使以色列遵守国际义务的法案。该组织将于周一提出的“红线”立法将禁止在可能违反澳大利亚国际人权义务的情况下使用国防设备、技术或服务。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This legislation reflects a commitment to ethical governance and accountability, seeking to ensure that Australian-made technology does not contribute to human rights abuses. It echoes the ancient call to 'do justice,' urging leaders to consider the moral implications of their actions and policies on the global stage.
reflection.zh: 这项立法体现了对道德治理和问责制的承诺，旨在确保澳大利亚制造的技术不助长侵犯人权的行为。它呼应了古老的“秉行公义”的呼召，敦促领导者考虑其行动和政策在全球舞台上的道德影响。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

The first episode of 'The...

reflection.en: This investigation into political funding uncovers a hidden flow of resources, challenging public trust and raising questions about accountability. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness is found not in grand pronouncements, but in acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh. May we seek transparency and integrity in all...
reflection.zh: 这项对政治资金的调查揭露了隐藏的资源流动，挑战了公众的信任并引发了对问责制的质疑。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义不在于宏大的宣告，而在于行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。愿我们在所有领域，尤其是在涉及公众信任的领域，寻求透明和正直。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 'Living in an online world': Why this state is cutting back on classroom screen time
title.zh: “活在网络世界”：为什么这个州要减少课堂屏幕时间

summary.en: A new policy will limit device usage to as little as 15 minutes per day for younger students, with mandatory implementation from 2028, following similar moves by the Victorian government. This initiative stems from research indicating excessive screen use is problematic, as stated by NSW Education Minister Prue Car.
summary.zh: 一项新政策将限制年幼学生每天使用设备的时间，最少为15分钟，并将于2028年强制实施，此前维多利亚州政府也采取了类似举措。新南威尔士州教育部长普鲁·卡表示，此举源于研究表明过度使用屏幕是一个问题。

body.en:
Students will be forced back to pen and paper as a state government moves to cap daily screen time to as little as 15 minutes against a backdrop of falling test scores.

New South Wales public schools will introduce daily screen-time limits for the start of the 2027 classroom year before the changes become mandatory from 2028 to allow time for teachers to make adjustments.

It follows similar moves from the Victorian government to reduce screen time in the classroom from 2027.

NSW Education Minister Prue Car said government research showed excessive screen use was a problem.

"An entire generation of students are increasingly living in an online world," she said on Sunday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"We have a responsibility to ensure their health and education isn't adversely affected by excessive screen use.

"When the research is telling us teenagers are spending as much as seven hours a day on screens and we are seeing reading and writing skills going backwards for a whole generation of children, we have to act."

Schools are advised to limit screen-based homework, with the use of digital devices not recommended before Year 5.

New state guidelines also recommend at least an hour daily of pen-and-paper learning, citing benefits of handwriting and reading print.

The move follows OECD Programme for International Student Assessment exam results showing Australian high school students registering record-low scores in mathematics and reading.

Australian students spend nearly twice as long using digital devices for learning compared to the OECD average.

Recent National Assessment Program Literacy and Numeracy results mirrored the findings.

About a third of students failed to meet basic benchmarks; reading scores dropped across all grades compared to the previous year, and only Year 5 students showed writing improvement.

Under the NSW policy, daily screen time limits — averaged across a school week — will be set at 15 minutes for kindergarten to Year 2, 30 minutes for Years 3–4 and 45 minutes for Years 5–6.

High school students are capped at one-quarter of class time per subject in Years 7–10 and up to half in Years 11–12.

There will be exemptions and adjustments for students with disability, those with additional needs, or students for whom English is not their first language, or where digital support is part of a personalised learning plan.

NSW Health chief paediatrician Helen Goodwin said it was important to limit screen time for children.

"A healthy day for children and young people includes a mix of being active, getting enough sleep, and building active social connections with their...
body.zh: 在考试成绩下降的背景下，州政府将每天的屏幕时间限制在 15 分钟，学生们将被迫重新使用笔和纸。 新南威尔士州公立学校将从 2027 学年开始引入每日屏幕时间限制，然后从 2028 年起强制实施，以便教师有时间进行调整。 此前，维多利亚州政府也采取了类似举措，从 2027 年起减少课堂上的屏幕时间。 新州教育部长 Prue Car 表示，政府研究表明过度使用屏幕是一个问题。 “整整一代学生越来越多地生活在网络世界中，”她周日表示。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我们有责任确保他们的健康和教育不会因过度使用屏幕而受到不利影响。 “当研究告诉我们青少年每天在屏幕上花费多达七个小时，并且我们看到整整一代孩子的阅读和写作技能在倒退时，我们必须采取行动。” 建议学校限制基于屏幕的家庭作业，并且不建议在五年级之前使用数字设备。 新的州指南还建议每天至少进行一小时的纸笔学习，并列举了手写和阅读印刷品的好处。 此前，经合组织国际学生评估计划考试结果显示，澳大利亚高中生的数学和阅读成绩创下历史新低。 与经合组织平均水平相比，澳大利亚学生使用数字设备进行学习的时间几乎是其两倍。 最近的国家读写和算术评估计划结果也反映了这一发现。 大约三分之一的学生未能达到基本标准；与上一年相比，所有年级的阅读成绩都有所下降，只有五年级学生的写作成绩有所提高。 根据新南威尔士州的政策，幼儿园至二年级的每日屏幕时间限制（整个学校周的平均时间）将被设定为 15 分钟，3-4 年级为 30 分钟，5-6 年级为 45 分钟。 高中生 7 至 10 年级每个科目的上课时间上限为四分之一，11 至 12 年级则上限为一半。 对于残疾学生、有额外需求的学生、英语不是母语的学生，或者数字支持是个性化学习计划一部分的学生，将会有豁免和调整。 新南威尔士州卫生局首席儿科医生海伦·古德温表示，限制儿童看屏幕的时间很重要。 “对于儿童和年轻人来说，健康的一天包括活跃、充足的睡眠以及与他们的……建立积极的社交联系。

reflection.en: As New South Wales schools move to limit screen time for young learners, the focus shifts back to foundational methods like pen and paper. This reflects a growing awareness that while technology offers much, the core task of forming young minds requires careful balance and intentionality, ensuring that educational tools serve, rather than hinder,...
reflection.zh: 随着新南威尔士州学校开始限制幼儿学习者使用屏幕的时间，焦点又回到了纸笔等基础教学方法上。这反映出一种日益增长的认识：尽管科技提供了许多便利，但塑造年轻心灵的核心任务需要仔细的平衡和深思熟虑，以确保教育工具能够促进而非阻碍其发展。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: 'Proud to be a houso': Anthony Albanese condemns Hanson's remarks on late mother
title.zh: “自豪是住公屋的”：安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯谴责汉森的关于他已故母亲的言论

summary.en: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has criticized Pauline Hanson's comments about his late mother living in public housing for decades, stating he is proud of his upbringing and defending his mother. The remarks were made in resurfaced footage where Hanson mocked Albanese's account of growing up in social housing.
summary.zh: 总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯批评了保琳·汉森关于他已故母亲数十年来一直住在公共住房的言论，他表示为自己的成长经历感到自豪，并捍卫了他的母亲。这些言论来自汉森在一个播客节目中被重新曝光的片段，她在节目中模仿阿尔巴尼斯哭泣，并嘲笑他讲述自己在悉尼西部公共住房中长大的经历。

body.en:
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has criticised Pauline Hanson's comments about his late mother living in public housing for decades, saying he was proud of his upbringing and defending his mother as "way out of Pauline Hanson's league". 

"She made comments about me being complaining about being growing up in public housing — nothing could be further from the truth," Albanese told reporters in Sydney on Sunday.

The comments follow resurfaced footage from Hanson's February appearance on a podcast, in which she mimicked Albanese crying while mocking his account of growing up in social housing in Sydney's inner west.

She argued Albanese's mother should not have remained in the same public housing property all her life.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Appearing on The Karl Stefanovic Show in February, the One Nation leader was asked about Albanese. In response, she feigned tears while delivering a joke impression of the prime minister.

"Oh, I've actually grew up in a housing commission house. You have no idea how hard it is to grow up in a housing commission house. Oh, my God... talk about a Prime Minister," Hanson said on the podcast.

Hanson added that she had grown up on a street with housing commission homes and that the people who lived in them "had jobs, they worked".

"He said his mother lived in the same one she was born in for 65 years. Sorry, that's not on, to me," she continued.

"It should be a limited time — you've been given a hand up, move it on to the next ones coming through."

On Friday, she doubled down on those comments, telling The Australian the prime minister "complains about his housing commission upbringing".

She also questioned Albanese's account compared to Australians "being forced to live in cars and tents" because of what she called "his government's high immigration numbers".

Albanese's mother, Maryanne, was a single mother and disability pensioner who lived with chronic rheumatoid arthritis for most of her adult life.

She died in 2002, aged 65, having spent decades in the same public housing property where Albanese also grew up.

Albanese gave an extended account of her life on Sunday morning, describing a woman who worked cleaning offices overnight to support him and who was left barely able to hold a knife and fork as her arthritis worsened.

"She was compassionate, not uncaring. She was generous, not mean. And she was kind, not nasty," Albanese said.

"She was a person of great character. She had a tough life … [but] she never complained. She never denigrated anyone.

"I grew up in a community that looked after each other. It was the opposite of being elite."

body.zh: 总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯批评了宝琳·汉森关于他已故母亲几十年来住在公共住房中的言论，称他为自己的成长感到自豪，并为自己的母亲辩护，认为“远远超出了宝琳·汉森的范围”。 “她评论说我抱怨在公共住房中长大——这与事实相差甚远，”阿尔巴尼斯周日在悉尼告诉记者。 这些评论是在汉森二月份出现在播客中的片段重新出现后发表的，其中她模仿阿尔巴尼斯的哭泣，同时嘲笑他在悉尼内西区社会住房中长大的经历。 她认为阿尔巴尼斯的母亲不应该一辈子住在同一个公共住房里。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这位一国党领导人在二月的卡尔·斯特凡诺维奇秀中被问及有关阿尔巴内塞的问题。对此，她假装流泪，并开玩笑地表达了对首相的印象。 “哦，我实际上是在住房委员会长大的。你不知道在住房委员会长大有多么困难。哦，我的上帝......谈论总理，”汉森在播客上说。 汉森补充说，她在一条有住房委员会住房的街道上长大，住在里面的人“有工作，他们工作”。 “他说他的母亲在她出生的那间房子里住了 65 年。抱歉，这对我来说不是，”她继续说道。 “这应该是一个有限的时间——你已经得到了帮助，把它转移到下一个过来的人身上。” 周五，她对这些评论加倍强调，告诉《澳大利亚人报》，总理“抱怨他的住房委员会的成长经历”。 她还质疑阿尔巴尼斯的说法，将澳大利亚人“被迫住在汽车和帐篷里”，因为她所说的“他的政府的移民人数很高”。 阿尔巴尼斯的母亲玛丽安娜是一位单亲母亲，也是一名残疾养老金领取者，她成年后的大部分时间都患有慢性类风湿性关节炎。 她于 2002 年去世，享年 65 岁，几十年来，她一直在阿尔巴尼斯长大的同一处公共住房中度过。 周日早上，阿尔巴内斯详细讲述了自己的生活，描述了一名为了支持他而通宵打扫办公室的妇女，由于关节炎恶化，她几乎无法拿刀叉。 “她富有同情心，而不是漠不关心。她很慷慨，而不是卑鄙。她很友善，而不是令人讨厌，”阿尔巴内塞说。 “她是一个性格伟大的人。她的生活很艰难……[但]她从不抱怨。她从不诋毁任何人。 “我在一个互相照顾的社区长大。这与精英相反。” 阿尔巴尼斯说他没有...

reflection.en: Public life often involves scrutiny, and sometimes personal attacks can target one's background. Prime Minister Albanese's response highlights the dignity inherent in all people, regardless of their housing situation. His pride in his upbringing and defense of his mother's character serve as a reminder that public service should be about serving the people...
reflection.zh: 公众生活常常伴随着审视，有时人身攻击会针对一个人的出身背景。阿尔巴尼斯总理的回应强调了所有人的内在尊严，无论他们的住房状况如何。他对自己的成长经历感到自豪，并捍卫他的母亲，这提醒我们，公职服务应是正直地为人民服务，而不是贬低他们的出身。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: 'Their kids have never seen their arm': The tattoos people are desperate to remove
title.zh: 后悔的17.9亿美元生意

summary.en: Tattoos were once considered permanent, but a growing industry now offers removal services. Mike Anderson, unable to find a clinic, opened his own, which has since expanded into a multi-location business, reflecting a shift in attitudes towards permanence.
summary.zh: 纹身曾被认为是永久的，但如今一个不断发展的行业提供了去除服务。迈克·安德森在找不到诊所后，自己开了一家，该诊所现已扩展为跨多地的业务，反映了人们对永久性的态度转变。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

But when Mike Anderson decided he no longer wanted his ink, he discovered just how difficult it was to undo the permanence.

Unable to find a laser tattoo-removal clinic in Sydney's inner-west, he and his wife decided to open one themselves.

Twelve years later, what began as a personal solution has grown into a business spanning 12 locations across NSW, Queensland and the United States — part of a booming industry built around a simple idea: what goes on the skin doesn't necessarily have to stay there.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

With more than a decade in the industry, Anderson says he has seen his fair share of tattoo regret stories .

"There was one from Bondi that said 'chicken' when they thought it said 'prosper'."

Anderson says the rise of fine-line and highly detailed tattoos has brought a new group of clients into removal clinics .

"With more detail comes more opportunity for mistakes and bad work. When they go wrong, they usually go noticeably wrong."

The growing demand for a second chance at unwanted ink is fuelling a booming global industry. The tattoo-removal market was worth an estimated US$1.29 billion ($1.79 billion) in 2025 and is forecast to reach US$4.87 billion ($6.75 billion) by 2034, according to Fortune Business Insights.

For some clients, the tattoos they want removed carry a darker history — racist symbols, hate-related words and, in some cases, racist slogans.

For five years, Anderson's clinic has run a charity program offering free removal of these tattoos.

"We've done al-Qaeda tattoos, we've done swastikas and white power symbols," he says.

Anderson says the aim is to help clients distance themselves from the beliefs these tattoos represent.

"The idea is that we take those tattoos and break the chain of influence, like, nephews, sons [and] daughters are less likely to fall into those same paths."

Anderson says the program attracts a high volume of applicants, but clients must demonstrate genuine remorse.

"We judge it on a case-by-case basis. We ask questions about the crimes they've committed; we expect transparency.

"They have to tell us what it means to them; are they looking to get employed? And make sure they're the right person."

Today's tattoo removal industry is part of a much longer story: how tattooing evolved from a practice associated with particular communities and subcultures into mainstream body art.

The State Library of Victoria estimates around a quarter of convicts sent to Australia had at least one tattoo.

Research by historian Simon Barnard, based on more than 10,000...
body.zh: 分享您的反馈并帮助我们改进此功能。请在此处详细了解我们如何在 SBS 使用人工智能。 但当迈克·安德森决定不再需要他的墨水时，他发现要消除这种永久性是多么困难。 由于在悉尼内西区找不到激光纹身去除诊所，他和妻子决定自己开一家。 12 年后，这家最初只是提供个人解决方案的公司现已发展成为一家业务遍及新南威尔士州、昆士兰州和美国 12 个地点的公司——这个蓬勃发展的行业的一部分围绕着一个简单的理念而建立：皮肤上的东西不一定要留在那里。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 安德森表示，在这个行业工作了十多年，他已经看到了很多纹身后悔的故事。 “邦迪有一个人说‘鸡’，而他们以为它说的是‘繁荣’。” 安德森说，细线和高度详细的纹身的兴起已经吸引了一批新的客户进入去除诊所。 “细节越多，出现错误和糟糕工作的机会就越多。当他们出错时，通常会出现明显的错误。” 对不需要的墨水的第二次机会不断增长的需求正在推动全球行业的蓬勃发展。据财富商业洞察 (Fortune Business Insights) 称，到 2025 年，纹身去除市场的价值估计为 12.9 亿美元（17.9 亿美元），预计到 2034 年将达到 48.7 亿美元（67.5 亿美元）。 对于一些客户来说，他们想要去除的纹身带有更黑暗的历史——种族主义符号、与仇恨相关的词语，在某些情况下，还有种族主义口号。 五年来，安德森的诊所一直在开展一项慈善计划，提供免费去除这些纹身的服务。 “我们纹了基地组织的纹身，我们纹了纳粹党徽和白人权力符号，”他说。 安德森说，目的是帮助客户远离这些纹身所代表的信仰。 “我们的想法是，我们采用这些纹身并打破影响链，例如，侄子、儿子和女儿就不太可能落入同样的道路。” 安德森表示，该计划吸引了大量申请人，但客户必须表现出真正的悔恨。 “我们根据具体情况进行判断。我们询问他们所犯下的罪行；我们期望透明度。 “他们必须告诉我们这对他们意味着什么；他们想找工作吗？并确保他们是合适的人选。” 今天的纹身去除行业是一个更长的故事的一部分：纹身如何从与特定社区和亚文化相关的实践演变为主流人体艺术。 维多利亚州立图书馆估计，大约四分之一被送往澳大利亚的囚犯至少有一个纹身。 历史学家西蒙·巴纳德 (Simon Barnard) 的研究基于 10,000 多个...

reflection.en: The desire to change or erase past decisions, like unwanted tattoos, speaks to a deep human longing for renewal. The story of Mike Anderson's business, born from a personal need and growing into a significant enterprise, reminds us that even in the pursuit of erasing the past, diligent work and entrepreneurial spirit can flourish. May we approach all our...
reflection.zh: 想要改变或抹去过去的决定，比如不想要的纹身，这反映了人类对更新的深切渴望。迈克·安德森的创业故事，源于个人需求并发展成为一项重要的事业，提醒我们即使在努力抹去过去时，勤奋工作和创业精神也能蓬勃发展。愿我们以同样的奉献精神对待我们所有的努力，无论是个人的还是职业的，并记住我们的工作可以是一种奉献。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Will Hong Kong’s educators learn from sliding Pisa results?
title.zh: 香港的教育工作者会从滑落的Pisa成绩中吸取教训吗？

summary.en: The latest Programme for International Student Assessment (Pisa) results show a decline in Hong Kong's performance, raising questions about whether the Education Bureau has learned from previous assessments, particularly concerning the new metric for creative thinking introduced in 2022.
summary.zh: 最新的国际学生能力评估计划（Pisa）结果显示，香港的教育表现有所下滑，这引发了关于教育局是否从以往的评估中吸取了教训的疑问，特别是关于2022年引入的衡量创造性思维的新指标。

body.en: The latest Programme for International Student Assessment (Pisa) results are out and unfortunately for the Education Bureau, Hong Kong’s performance looks bad. Is this the outcome of not learning from the last assessment? In the 2022 Pisa assessment, a metric for creative thinking was introduced to measure the ability to generate, evaluate, improve and communicate ideas, as well as social and scientific problem-solving. Hong Kong scored below the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and...
body.zh: 最新的国际学生评估计划（Pisa）结果已经出炉，不幸的是，对于教育局来说，香港的表现看起来很糟糕。难道这就是上次考核没有吸取教训的结果吗？ 2022 年 PISA 评估引入了创造性思维指标，用于衡量产生、评估、改进和交流想法的能力，以及解决社会和科学问题的能力。香港的得分低于经济合作组织...

reflection.en: The latest Pisa results for Hong Kong show a concerning slide, particularly in creative thinking. This suggests a need to re-evaluate how we are shaping the minds of the next generation. Proverbs 22:6 reminds us that the way we train the young today will guide their path tomorrow.
reflection.zh: 香港最新的Pisa成绩显示出令人担忧的下滑，尤其是在创造性思维方面。这表明我们需要重新评估我们正在如何塑造下一代的思想。《箴言》22章6节提醒我们，我们今天训练年轻人的方式将指引他们明天的道路。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.zh: 顶尖在线教育提供通往名牌大学的途径

Operating since 2019, the Crimson Global Academy (CGA) conducts small live group classes alongside one-to-one classes where a more personalised pace is helpful. Everything follows a...

Committing such endeavors to God's guidance can lead to success and fulfillment, ensuring the work serves a greater purpose beyond academic achievement. Yahweh的指引和祝福可以成就一项事业。Crimson Global Academy...

title.en: Supplier to end classroom lunch portioning at Sha Tin school after 39 fall ill
title.zh: 沙田一学校午餐供应商因39人患病后停止课室分餐

summary.en: A lunch supplier will cease portioning meals in classrooms at a Hong Kong primary school after a suspected food poisoning outbreak affected 39 students and staff last week. The supplier stated the incident was isolated and linked to the school's portioning arrangement, not their general service.
summary.zh: 在接连发生疑似食物中毒事件，导致39名学生和教职员受影响后，一家午餐供应商将停止在香港一所小学课室内分餐。该供应商表示，此次事件是孤立的，并与学校的分餐安排有关，而非其普遍服务。

body.en: A lunch supplier will stop portioning meals in classrooms at a Hong Kong primary school following a suspected food poisoning outbreak that hit 39 pupils and staff members last week. Danny Catering Service said in a statement on Sunday to its school partners, parents and teachers that the incident was “isolated” and linked to the school’s portioning arrangement, and did not affect its services at other locations. “To ensure student food safety and avoid potential cross-contamination or...
body.zh: 上周，香港一所小学爆发疑似食物中毒事件，造成 39 名学生和教职员工中毒，午餐供应商将停止在教室里分发餐食。丹尼餐饮服务公司周日在给学校合作伙伴、家长和老师的一份声明中表示，这起事件是“孤立的”，与学校的分配安排有关，不会影响其在其他地点的服务。 “为了确保学生食品安全并避免潜在的交叉污染或......

reflection.en: When food meant to nourish instead causes harm, it points to a breakdown in care and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true service involves not only providing goods but doing so with justice and mercy, ensuring the well-being of those we serve. May businesses always prioritize ethical practices and the health of their communities.
reflection.zh: 当本应滋养的食物反而导致伤害时，这便显露出关怀和问责的失职。弥迦书6章8节提醒我们，真正的服务不仅在于提供商品，更在于秉持公义和怜悯，确保服务对象的福祉。愿各商家永远将道德实践和社区的健康置于首位。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Over 700 report unauthorised phone purchases: police
title.zh: 警方：超过700人举报未经授权的电话购买

summary.en: Police reported receiving over 700 complaints from individuals in Hong Kong whose credit card details were stolen and used to purchase smartphones, totaling nearly HK$15 million. The fraudulent purchases, often for new iPhones during pre-order launches, are being investigated as obtaining property by deception.
summary.zh: 警方报告称，香港有超过700人投诉其信用卡信息被盗，并被用于购买智能手机，涉案金额近1500万港元。这些欺诈性购买，常发生在新款iPhone的预购期间，警方正将其作为欺诈财产罪进行调查。

body.en: Police said on Sunday they received over 700 reports from people saying their credit card details have been stolen and used to buy smartphones, involving a total of nearly HK$15 million. There's been a flurry of posts on social media from people in Hong Kong saying their cards have been used to buy the new iPhone during a pre-order launch. Police say cases reported to them involve a total of HK$14.7 million, with one of them alone amounting to HK$114,000. Officers say they are treating the matter as obtaining property by deception, with no arrests so far. Major banks have also launched investigations, with HSBC and Standard Chartered both saying they will help affected customers reverse the transactions. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 警方周日表示，他们收到超过 700 起举报，称他们的信用卡信息被盗并被用来购买智能手机，涉案总额近 1,500 万港元。香港人在社交媒体上发了一系列帖子，称他们的卡在预购期间被用来购买新款 iPhone。警方表示，接获的案件总金额为1,470万港元，其中一宗案件的涉案金额高达114,000港元。警方表示，他们将此事视为通过欺骗手段获取财产，目前尚未逮捕任何人。各大银行也已展开调查，汇丰银行和渣打银行均表示将帮助受影响的客户扭转交易。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The news from Hong Kong reveals a disturbing trend where personal financial information is stolen and exploited for personal gain, amounting to millions of dollars. This highlights the pervasive temptation and danger associated with the pursuit of wealth, reminding us that the love of money can lead individuals down paths of deceit and harm to others.
reflection.zh: 香港的这则新闻揭示了一种令人不安的趋势：个人财务信息被盗并被用于牟利，涉案金额高达数百万美元。这凸显了追求财富所带来的普遍诱惑和危险，提醒我们贪财之心可能将个人引向欺骗和伤害他人的道路。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

The pursuit of possessions, when unchecked by ethical considerations, can fuel greed and result in harm to others. This reminds us to examine our own desires and ensure they are not leading us into temptation or...

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.

title.en: FS hails deepening HK, Belt-Road connections
title.zh: 财爷称赞港与‘一带一路’联系日益深化

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan stated on Sunday that Hong Kong's ties with Belt and Road regions and the Global South have strengthened, driven by advancements in its innovation and technology capabilities. He noted in his blog that collaboration with the Middle East is expanding beyond finance into industry-focused...
summary.zh: 财政司司长陈茂波周日表示，香港与‘一带一路’沿线地区及全球南方的联系日益深化，这得益于香港创新科技能力的持续增长。他在每周网志中指出，香港与中东的合作已从金融业扩展到以产业为导向的创新科技领域，将经济和投资关系带入更广阔的范畴。他还提到，香港与‘一带一路’地区的合作正从个别项目转向更全面的联系，并利用香港强大的科研和创...

body.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan on Sunday said Hong Kong’s connections with Belt and Road regions and the Global South have deepened, with the continuous growth in Hong Kong’s innovation and technology ability. Writing in his weekly blog, Chan said Hong Kong’s collaboration with the Middle East has been expanding from finance to the industry-oriented innovation and technology sector, bringing the economic and investment relationship to a broader scope. Hong Kong’s cooperation with Belt and Road regions is also evolving from individual projects into comprehensive connections, he said. Chan said the SAR’s strong scientific research and innovation capabilities allow the cross-regional cooperation to extend into the I&T area. Hong Kong’s innovation ability has been on the rise, with the number of startups in the city surging from over 1,500 in 2015 to more than 5,200 last year, he said. “For partners in the Middle East and Central Asia, this means what they can find in Hong Kong is feasible innovation, commercialised application and high-end industrial capability,” he said. “When these abilities are combined with the advanced manufacturing capacity and the vast market in our sister cities in the Greater Bay Area, the results are not only commercial returns, but also high-quality development that benefits all parties.” The FS also said Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and the latest Policy Address would become the market’s focus in the coming week. The documents will allow the market to further understand Hong Kong’s future development and policies, and better plan for further investments and business development in the city and across the region. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 财政司司长陈茂波周日表示，香港与“一带一路”地区和南半球的联系日益加深，香港的创新科技能力不断增强。陈茂波在每周博客中表示，香港与中东的合作已从金融扩展到以工业为导向的创新科技领域，将经济和投资关系拓展到更广泛的范围。他表示，香港与“一带一路”地区的合作也正在从个别项目发展为全面联系。陈肇始表示，特区强大的科研创新能力，让跨区域合作延伸至创科领域。他表示，香港的创新能力不断增强，香港初创企业数量从2015年的1,500多家激增至去年的5,200多家。 “对于中东和中亚的合作伙伴来说，这意味着他们在香港可以找到可行的创新、商业化应用和高端产业能力，”他说。 “当这些能力与大湾区友好城市的先进制造能力和广阔市场相结合时，带来的不仅仅是商业回报，更是惠及各方的高质量发展。”财政司司长还表示，香港的第一个五年计划和最新的施政报告将成为未来一周市场的焦点。这些文件将使市场进一步了解香港未来的发展和政策，并更好地规划香港及整个地区的进一步投资和业务发展。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan's blog post highlights Hong Kong's expanding collaborations and growing innovation, framing these efforts as a pathway to deeper economic and investment relationships. This focus on diligent work and strategic development echoes the wisdom of committing one's endeavors to divine guidance, trusting that Yahweh will establish the...
reflection.zh: 财政司司长陈茂波的网志强调了香港日益扩大的合作和不断增长的创新，并将这些努力视为深化经济和投资关系的途径。这种对勤奋工作和战略发展的关注，呼应了将我们的努力托付给神圣指引的智慧，相信雅伟会成就我们所规划的事业。当香港寻求建立桥梁和促进增长时，将工作托付给更高力量的原则为持续的成功和合乎道德的进步奠定了基础。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Northern Metropolis: Hong Kong homes flattened for HK$224 billion high-tech hub
title.zh: 北部都會區：香港房屋被夷平以建造2240億港元高科技中心

summary.en: Chan Yuk-tong, a 71-year-old resident, had hoped to live out his remaining years in his ancestral home in a Hong Kong village. However, his home, along with a significant portion of Hong Kong's land including villages, wetlands, and farmland, is slated for demolition to create the "Northern Metropolis," a massive...
summary.zh: 71歲的陳玉棠原本希望在他出生和長大的藍磚屋村度過餘生，但他的香港鄉村住宅即將被夷為平地，為一個龐大的高科技中心讓路。該項目名為「北部都會區」，佔地相當於香港三分之一的面積，包括村莊、濕地和農田，耗資2240億港元。政府官員已於2026年6月23日在香港北部新界古洞區展開土地收回行動，影響了陳先生和蘇女士等居民。

body.en: Chan Yuk-tong hoped to spend his remaining years in the row of small, blue-brick houses where he was born and raised, but the 71-year-old’s Hong Kong village home will soon be bulldozed to make way for a vast tech hub. Resident Niki So (L1) and her family stand behind the gate of their village house as Hong Kong government officers carry out a land resumption operation against them in the Kwu Tung area of Hong Kong’s northern New Territories, on June 23, 2026. Photo: Leung Man Hei. An area roughly a third of Hong Kong including villages, natural wetlands and farmland is being converted into the “Northern Metropolis”, an ambitious project aimed at deepening integration with the mainland, diversifying the economy and providing new homes. “I can’t bear to leave… If not for the government developing this area, I would likely spend the rest of my life here. After all, I belong here,” Chan told AFP as he packed up belongings in his yard. Touted as a “new economic engine” to accommodate around 2.5 million residents and provide 650,000 jobs, the project will link Hong Kong more closely with Macau and nine cities in mainland China that make up the Greater Bay Area. Embed from Getty Images But the government’s vision for a Silicon Valley-like high-tech hub in Hong Kong comes at a huge cost to the city’s wildlife, local communities and public finances, environmental and social groups warned. “If you build a new city in a place that was well preserved before, it would inevitably be very destructive, no matter how you mitigate it,” said Brian Wong of Liber Research Community, an NGO focused on land issues. “Do we need to build it so big? Is it too ambitious?” he added. Return on investment The Northern Metropolis project, announced five years ago, will eventually cover 30,000 hectares (74,000 acres). Liber said at least 25 villages will be demolished to make way for it. Government departments told AFP they aim to integrate rural areas into the development project, but that Chan’s ancestral houses were not culturally significant enough to preserve. Plans to integrate Hong Kong with mainland China have long faced opposition in the former British colony, where critics warn such moves would erode the city’s autonomy. But a sweeping national security law imposed by Beijing on Hong Kong in 2020 after huge pro-democracy protests has stymied dissent in the financial hub. It “effectively put an end to the ‘one country, two systems’ framework that allowed Hong Kong a ‘high degree of autonomy’, so greater integration with the Greater Bay Area would logically follow,” Steve Tsang, director of the SOAS China Institute, told AFP....
body.zh: 陈玉堂希望能在他出生和长大的一排青砖小房子里度过余生，但这位 71 岁的香港乡村住宅很快就会被推平，为一个巨大的科技中心让路。 2026 年 6 月 23 日，香港政府官员在香港新界北部古洞地区对居民进行收地行动，居民苏妮琪（左一）和她的家人站在村屋门后。照片：梁文熙。香港约三分之一的地区，包括村庄、自然湿地和农田，正在转变为“北方都会区”，这是一个雄心勃勃的项目，旨在深化与内地的融合、经济多元化和提供新家园。 “我舍不得离开……如果不是政府开发这个地区，我可能会在这里度过余生。毕竟，我属于这里，”陈先生在自家院子里收拾行李时告诉法新社。该项目被誉为“新经济引擎”，可容纳约250万居民并提供65万个就业岗位，将更紧密地连接香港与澳门以及构成大湾区的中国内地九个城市。但环境和社会团体警告说，政府在香港建立类似硅谷的高科技中心的愿景是以该市的野生动物、当地社区和公共财政付出巨大代价为代价的。专注于土地问题的非政府组织 Liber Research Community 的布莱恩·王 (Brian Wong) 表示：“如果你在以前保存完好的地方建造一座新城市，无论你如何减轻影响，都将不可避免地造成很大的破坏。” “我们需要把它建得这么大吗？是不是太雄心勃勃了？”他补充道。投资回报五年前宣布的北方都市项目最终将占地 30,000 公顷（74,000 英亩）。利伯表示，至少有 25 个村庄将被拆除，为其让路。政府部门告诉法新社，他们的目标是将农村地区纳入开发项目，但陈氏祖屋的文化意义不足以保护。香港与中国大陆融合的计划长期以来一直遭到这个前英国殖民地的反对，批评人士警告称，此类举措将削弱香港的自治权。但在大规模的民主抗议活动之后，北京于 2020 年对香港实施了一项全面的国家安全法，平息了这个金融中心的异议。伦敦亚非学院中国研究院院长曾锐生告诉法新社，它“有效地结束了允许香港‘高度自治’的‘一国两制’框架，因此顺理成章地与大湾区进一步融合。”

reflection.en: The development of Hong Kong's "Northern Metropolis" promises technological advancement but displaces long-time residents like 71-year-old Chan Yuk-tong from their homes. This raises questions about the balance between progress and the human cost, particularly for those rooted in their communities. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to "execute justice and...
reflection.zh: 香港「北部都會區」的發展承諾帶來科技進步，卻也迫使像71歲的陳玉棠這樣的長期居民離開他們的家園。這引發了關於發展與人類代價之間平衡的質疑，特別是對那些根植於社區的人們。耶利米書22:3呼籲統治者「施行公平和公義，拯救被欺壓的脫離欺壓者的手。」願領導者在他們宏偉的規劃中，永遠顧念所有人民的福祉，尤其是弱勢群體。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Macau to hold closed-door trial in first national security case against democrat
title.zh: 澳门将在首次国家安全案中对民主派人士进行不公开审判

summary.en: Macau is set to hold its first national security trial next week behind closed doors for a former pro-democracy lawmaker accused of "subversion." This follows an expansion of national security laws in May 2023 and a new bill allowing closed-door hearings in such cases, raising concerns among legal experts and rights...
summary.zh: 澳门法院周五表示，下周将就首起国家安全案件举行不公开审判，被告是一名被控“颠覆罪”的前亲民主议员。此前，中国这个博彩中心于2023年5月扩大了国家安全法的适用范围，并于今年早些时候通过了一项新法案，允许法官在国家安全案件中进行不公开审理。律师和人权组织警告称，此规定可能会破坏政府部门的运作，并适用于“任何司法案件”。

body.en: Macau will hold its first national security trial behind closed doors next week, a court said on Friday, in a case against a former pro-democracy lawmaker charged with “subversion”. Former Macau lawmaker Au Kam San. File photo: Au Kam San, via Facebook. The Chinese casino hub expanded the scope of national security laws in May 2023, and a new bill passed earlier this year allows judges to hear national security cases behind closed doors. Lawyers and rights groups have warned that the rule could undermine the functioning of government departments and apply to “any judicial case”. Former Macau lawmaker Au Kam San in July 2025 became the first person to be arrested under the expanded law, with authorities alleging he had ties to foreign groups endangering China. The judge decided to “hold the trial behind closed doors in order to ensure that national security interests are not compromised”, a statement released by Macau’s final appeals court said. After Au’s arrest, details about the case remained scarce until this July, when judicial authorities in Macau confirmed that he would stand trial as a “principal offender” of subversion and other crimes. The court said the trial decision had been confirmed by Macau’s national security committee, following a request from the city’s public prosecutions office. The proceedings are set to begin September 16. Au, 69, is a primary school teacher who became one of Macau’s longest-serving pro-democracy legislators before deciding not to seek re-election in 2021. Authorities said that a court-appointed lawyer previously accepted by Au will continue to represent him. Macau flag. Photo: gavindeas, via Flickr. Michael Polak, a London-based barrister representing Au, said earlier this year that authorities having “appointed a state lawyer does not remedy the fundamental deficiencies in these proceedings which have all the appearances of a show trial”. “He is a Portuguese national and has been kept incommunicado for one year without access to his family or an independent lawyer,” Polak added. Au’s daughter Cherry said the family is not allowed to visit or communicate with him. “All we ask for is a fair trial, due process, and for his more than three decades of dedication to the people of Macau not to be erased or forgotten,” she said in a statement in July. Under Macau’s security law, subversion offences are subject to a prison term of up to 25 years.
body.zh: 一家法院周五表示，澳门将于下周举行首次国家安全审判，审理一名被控“颠覆国家政权”的前民主派议员的案件。前澳门议员区锦新。资料图：区金山，来自 Facebook。中国赌场中心于 2023 年 5 月扩大了国家安全法的范围，今年早些时候通过的一项新法案允许法官闭门审理国家安全案件。律师和人权组织警告说，该规则可能会损害政府部门的运作，并适用于“任何司法案件”。 2025 年 7 月，前澳门议员区锦新成为根据扩大后的法律被捕的第一人，当局指控他与危害中国的外国组织有联系。澳门终审法院发布的一份声明称，法官决定“闭门审理，以确保国家安全利益不受影响”。区被捕后，有关案件的细节一直很少，直到今年7月，澳门司法当局确认他将作为颠覆国家政权和其他罪行的“主犯”接受审判。法院表示，应澳门检察机关的要求，澳门国家安全委员会确认了审判决定。诉讼程序定于 9 月 16 日开始。区先生现年 69 岁，是一名小学教师，在决定不再寻求 2021 年连任之前，他成为澳门任职时间最长的民主派立法会议员之一。当局表示，区先生之前接受的一名法院指定的律师将继续代表他。澳门旗。照片：gavindeas，来自 Flickr。代表 Au 的驻伦敦大律师迈克尔·波拉克 (Michael Polak) 今年早些时候表示，当局“任命一名国家律师并没有弥补这些诉讼程序中的根本缺陷，这些诉讼程序看起来像是一场表演审判”。波拉克补充说：“他是葡萄牙国民，已被单独监禁一年，无法与家人或独立律师见面。” Au的女儿Cherry表示，家人不被允许探望或与他交流。她在七月的一份声明中表示：“我们所要求的只是公平审判、正当程序，以及他三十多年来对澳门人民的奉献不被抹去或遗忘。”根据澳门国安法，颠覆罪可被判处最高25年监禁。

reflection.en: The news from Macau, where a former lawmaker faces trial behind closed doors for alleged subversion, evokes Proverbs 28:15: "Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a poor people." The secrecy surrounding the trial raises concerns about justice and the potential for unchecked power to silence dissent, echoing the prophet's warning...
reflection.zh: 澳门前议员因涉嫌“颠覆罪”面临不公开审判的消息，令人联想起《箴言》28章15节：“恶劣的统治者统治贫苦的民众，如同咆哮的狮子或凶猛的熊。”审判的秘密性引发了对公正的担忧，以及不受制约的权力压制异议的可能性，这与先知对压迫性领导的警告不谋而合。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Astronomers unmask a supernova impostor
title.zh: 天文学家揭开超新星“冒名顶替者”的面纱

summary.en: Astronomers have been studying a distant star, AT 2016blu, for the past decade, anticipating it might explode as a supernova. However, new research indicates that its outbursts are caused by a previously unseen companion star, not an impending catastrophic explosion. This star is located approximately 29 million...
summary.zh: 过去十年，一颗遥远的恒星AT 2016blu吸引了天文学家的注意，它似乎预示着即将发生超新星爆炸。然而，新的研究表明，其爆发是由一个先前未被发现的伴星引起的，而非迫在眉睫的灾难性爆炸。这颗恒星距离我们约2900万光年，质量约为太阳的33倍。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A distant star has captured astronomers' attention over the past decade, teasing them with indications that it will soon explode as a supernova. But new research shows that something else entirely is behind the star's outbursts. Rather than an impending catastrophic explosion, a previously unseen companion may be responsible for the star's behavior.

The star is named AT 2016blu and is about 29 million light-years away (about 170 trillion miles). It's an enormous star, about 33 times as massive as the sun. Stars this massive end their lives in brilliant supernova explosions, leading astronomers to think that an explosion was imminent.

But new research to be published in The Astrophysical Journal outlines what's actually happening with AT 2016blu. The research is titled " AT 2016blu: Accretion-Powered Outbursts in a Luminous Blue Variable and Compact Object Binary ," and is currently available at arXiv.org. The lead author is Mojgan Aghakhanloo, an astronomer at the University of Virginia.

AT 2016blu is a luminous blue variable star discovered in 2012. It exhibits periodic outbursts that are very supernova-like. Since its discovery, it has erupted 27 times. While astronomers now know that not every supernova experiences pre-explosion eruptions, many do, so they rightly thought that AT 2016blu was an impending supernova.

This isn't Aghakhanloo's first research into AT 2016blu, which has earned the nickname "supernova impostor." Papers published in 2023 and 2025 also focused on the impostor. That research suggested that a binary system was responsible and that no supernova explosion was coming. But it left many unanswered questions.

"AT 2016blu exhibited 27 detected quasiperiodic (~113-day) outbursts between 2012 and June 2026, presumably triggered by periastron passages in an eccentric binary system in which the primary is a ≳33 M ⊙ luminous blue variable (LBV)," the authors write.

This latest research presents new X-ray observations of AT 2016blu. These observations, combined with serendipitous X-ray observations of the star from decades ago, show that rather than supernova activity, the star's outbursts are caused by interactions with a binary companion.

"We knew when the next outburst should be," Aghakhanloo said in a press release . That knowledge let Aghakhanloo and her fellow researchers schedule more observations. Multiple astronomers at different telescopes helped, and more than 30 amateur astronomers joined the effort.

The observation effort culminated in March 2026 during AT 2016blu's peak outburst. At that time, the researchers triggered a "Target of...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： A distant star has captured astronomers' attention over the past decade, teasing them with indications that it will soon explode as a supernova.但新的研究表明，这颗恒星爆发的背后完全有其他原因。这颗恒星的行为可能不是即将发生的灾难性爆炸造成的，而是之前未曾见过的伴星造成的。 这颗恒星被命名为 AT 2016blu，距离我们约 2900 万光年（约 170 万亿英里）。它是一颗巨大的恒星，质量约为太阳的 33 倍。如此巨大的恒星在辉煌的超新星爆炸中结束了自己的生命，导致天文学家认为爆炸即将发生。 但即将发表在《天体物理学杂志》上的新研究概述了 AT 2016blu 的实际情况。该研究的标题为“AT 2016blu：发光蓝色变量和紧凑物体二进制中的吸积动力爆发”，目前可在 arXiv.org 上获取。主要作者是弗吉尼亚大学的天文学家 Mojgan Aghakhanloo。 AT 2016blu 是一颗发光的蓝色变星，于 2012 年发现。它表现出非常像超新星的周期性爆发。自被发现以来，它已经喷发了27次。虽然天文学家现在知道并非所有超新星都会经历爆炸前的喷发，但很多超新星都会经历，因此他们正确地认为 AT 2016blu 是一颗即将发生的超新星。 这并不是 Aghakhanloo 第一次对 AT 2016blu 进行研究，AT 2016blu 赢得了“超新星冒名顶替者”的绰号。 2023 年和 2025 年发表的论文也聚焦于冒名顶替者。该研究表明，双星系统是造成这一现象的原因，并且没有超新星爆炸即将发生。但它留下了许多悬而未决的问题。 作者写道：“2012 年至 2026 年 6 月期间，AT 2016blu 展示了 27 次检测到的准周期（约 113 天）爆发，可能是由偏心双星系统中的近星体通道触发的，其中主星是 ≳33 M ⊙ 发光蓝色变星 (LBV)。” 这项最新研究展示了 AT 2016blu 的新 X 射线观测结果。这些观测结果与几十年前对这颗恒星偶然进行的 X 射线观测相结合，表明这颗恒星的爆发不是超新星活动，而是由与双星伴星的相互作用引起的。 “我们知道下一次爆发应该在什么时候，”阿加坎卢在一份新闻稿中说。这些知识让阿加汉卢和她的研究同事们安排了更多的观察。来自不同望远镜的多名天文学家提供了帮助，30 多名业余天文学家也加入了这项工作。 观测工作于 2026 年 3 月 AT 2016blu 高峰爆发期间达到顶峰。当时，研究人员触发了“目标......

reflection.en: The vastness of space and the intricate dance of celestial bodies continue to reveal wonders. As astronomers peer into the cosmos, they uncover the complex workings of stars like AT 2016blu, reminding us of the profound order and mystery that surrounds us. The heavens indeed declare the glory of their Creator, inviting us to contemplate the scale and beauty...
reflection.zh: 浩瀚的宇宙和天体的精密运行不断揭示着奇迹。当天文学家们审视宇宙时，他们发现了像AT 2016blu这样的恒星复杂的运作方式，提醒我们周围充满着深刻的秩序和奥秘。诸天确实述说着造物主的荣耀，邀请我们去沉思祂创造的宏大规模和美丽。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: AI helps microscopes find the most informative nanoscale features in a sample
title.zh: 人工智能帮助显微镜在样本中找到最具信息量的纳米尺度特征

summary.en: Researchers at Oak Ridge National Laboratory have developed an AI framework that assists in using atomic force microscopes to identify key nanoscale features, autonomously directing the microscope to the most informative areas for detailed study.
summary.zh: 橡树岭国家实验室的研究人员开发了一个人工智能框架，该框架有助于使用原子力显微镜识别关键的纳米尺度特征，并自主地将显微镜引导至信息量最大的区域进行详细研究。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Researchers at the Department of Energy's Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) have developed an artificial intelligence framework that helps researchers use atomic force microscopes to identify important nanoscale features while autonomously targeting the most informative areas of a sample for closer study.

Although atomic force microscopy (AFM) reveals structures as small as molecules, operating the instrument still requires expert judgment about where to scan, how to adjust settings and which features deserve closer study. SimuScan reduces that burden, making AFM faster, more consistent and better suited for high-throughput research.

"Operating an atomic force microscope is a bit like piloting a modern jet," said Liam Collins, an ORNL senior R&D scientist at the Center for Nanophase Materials Sciences (CNMS). "The hardware has incredible capability, but making full use of it often requires an experienced pilot." That reliance on specialized expertise slows large-scale studies and makes results more dependent on individual users.

"The challenge is not only acquiring the image but also understanding what is in the image, deciding what matters and knowing where the microscope should look next," said Ruben Millan Solsona, an ORNL technical professional and staff scientist.

In a paper published in Nature Communications , the researchers describe how SimuScan addresses one of AI's biggest obstacles for AFM: the shortage of high-quality labeled training data.

At first glance, interpreting AFM images looks like a standard image-analysis problem. But AFM images differ fundamentally from photographs because they reflect both the sample and the measurement process.

"A camera records reflected light, but an atomic force microscope acts more like a high-tech record player needle feeling its way across a landscape," Collins said. What the microscope records depends on the sample, the AFM probe itself and the way it is measured.

Millan Solsona put it simply: "Tip geometry, drift, flattening and contamination can all introduce artifacts that resemble real nanoscale structures. Experienced users learn to distinguish them; AI models must be taught to do the same."

Training data are also scarce. Unlike everyday photographs or medical images, relatively few AFM images have been carefully labeled by experts, making it difficult to train AI models.

SimuScan tackles the data problem by generating synthetic AFM images, along with automatic labels tied directly to the simulated object geometry, so models can be trained without large volumes of hand-annotated experimental data.

To...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 美国能源部橡树岭国家实验室 (ORNL) 的研究人员开发了一种人工智能框架，可帮助研究人员使用原子力显微镜识别重要的纳米级特征，同时自动瞄准样本中信息最丰富的区域进行进一步研究。 尽管原子力显微镜（AFM）揭示了像分子一样小的结构，但操作该仪器仍然需要专家判断扫描位置、如何调整设置以及哪些特征值得进一步研究。 SimuScan 减轻了这种负担，使 AFM 更快、更一致并且更适合高通量研究。 “操作原子力显微镜有点像驾驶现代喷气式飞机，”橡树岭国家实验室纳米材料科学中心 (CNMS) 高级研发科学家利亚姆·柯林斯 (Liam Collins) 说。 “硬件具有令人难以置信的功能，但充分利用它通常需要经验丰富的飞行员。”对专业知识的依赖会减慢大规模研究的速度，并使结果更加依赖于个人用户。 “挑战不仅在于获取图像，还在于了解图像中的内容、决定重要的内容以及了解显微镜接下来应该观察的位置，”橡树岭国家实验室技术专家兼科学家鲁本·米兰·索尔索纳 (Ruben Millan Solsona) 说。 在《自然通讯》上发表的一篇论文中，研究人员描述了 SimuScan 如何解决 AI 对 AFM 的最大障碍之一：高质量标记训练数据的短缺。 乍一看，解释 AFM 图像看起来像是一个标准的图像分析问题。但 AFM 图像与照片有根本的不同，因为它们既反映了样品又反映了测量过程。 柯林斯说：“相机记录反射光，但原子力显微镜的作用更像是高科技电唱机的针在风景中摸索。”显微镜记录的内容取决于样品、AFM 探针本身及其测量方式。 Millan Solsona 简单地说：“尖端几何形状、漂移、扁平化和污染都会引入类似于真实纳米级结构的伪影。经验丰富的用户学会区分它们；必须教会人工智能模型做同样的事情。” 训练数据也稀缺。与日常照片或医学图像不同，经过专家仔细标记的 AFM 图像相对较少，这使得训练 AI 模型变得困难。 SimuScan 通过生成合成 AFM 图像以及直接与模拟对象几何形状相关的自动标签来解决数据问题，因此无需大量手工注释的实验数据即可训练模型。 到...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, as seen in this AI-powered microscopy, reflects a biblical observation that in the end times, knowledge will increase. This surge in understanding, while powerful, calls for wisdom and discernment in its application, ensuring it serves humanity's true needs.
reflection.zh: 正如这项人工智能驱动的显微镜技术所展示的，技术的飞速发展反映了圣经中关于末世知识增长的观察。这种理解力的激增虽然强大，但需要智慧和辨别力来应用，以确保它能满足人类的真正需求。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Scientists find a new layer of Alzheimer’s hidden in the genome
title.zh: 科学家在基因组中发现阿尔茨海默病的新层级

summary.en: Scientists have identified a previously overlooked aspect of Alzheimer's disease by observing disruptions in the 3D organization of DNA within affected brain cells. This change impacts how crucial genes are regulated, suggesting new avenues for treatment research.
summary.zh: 科学家通过观察受阿尔茨海默病影响的脑细胞中DNA的三维组织结构发生紊乱，发现了一种先前被忽视的疾病层面。这种变化影响了重要基因的开关方式，为治疗研究开辟了新途径。

body.en:
Researchers at Carnegie Mellon University's School of Computer Science, the University of Pittsburgh School of Medicine and the University of Washington have uncovered a previously underexplored feature of Alzheimer's disease that may help scientists identify new avenues for treatment.

The study, published in Science , found that the three-dimensional organization of the genome differs in certain brain cells from people with Alzheimer's disease. Scientists from SCS's Ray and Stephanie Lane Computational Biology Department, Pitt's Department of Neurobiology, and collaborating institutions connected these changes in genome folding with shifts in gene activity and the organization of brain tissue.

To build this detailed picture, the team combined single-cell technology, spatial mapping of brain tissue, and a newly developed deep learning model.

"Alzheimer's disease cannot be understood one layer at a time," said Jian Ma, the Ray and Stephanie Lane Professor of Computational Biology who led and supervised the study. "The genome's 3D structure is a fundamental regulatory layer that helps to connect DNA sequence to gene activity. By integrating genome folding, cell state, and tissue context, we can move beyond cataloging disease-associated changes toward understanding how they fit together and which mechanisms to test next."

DNA does not sit inside a cell as a simple straight strand. Instead, it folds into a complex three-dimensional structure that helps determine which genes are accessible and active. Changes in that physical organization can therefore influence how cells function.

The researchers examined postmortem samples from the prefrontal cortex, an area at the front of the brain. The tissue came from people with and without Alzheimer's disease who had taken part in a long-term dementia study and later donated their brains for research.

The team used GAGE-seq, a technique that can measure both gene expression and three-dimensional genome contacts within the same individual cell. Those measurements were then combined with spatial transcriptomic maps, which preserve information about where gene activity occurs within intact brain tissue.

By bringing these datasets together, the researchers were able to connect the physical organization of the genome with gene regulation while also seeing where Alzheimer's related molecular and cellular changes appeared within the surrounding tissue.

"Our study represents a major advance in understanding what goes wrong in Alzheimer's disease," said Hansruedi Mathys, assistant professor of neurobiology at Pitt's Department of Neurobiology, who directed the Pitt arm of the study. "We know the classic hallmarks of Alzheimer's disease - accumulation of amyloid-beta plaques and tau tangles - but our results...
body.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学计算机科学学院、匹兹堡大学医学院和华盛顿大学的研究人员发现了阿尔茨海默病的一个先前未被充分研究的特征，这可能有助于科学家找到新的治疗途径。 这项发表在《科学》杂志上的研究发现，某些脑细胞中基因组的三维组织与阿尔茨海默病患者不同。来自 SCS 雷和斯蒂芬妮莱恩计算生物学系、皮特神经生物学系和合作机构的科学家将基因组折叠的这些变化与基因活性和脑组织组织的变化联系起来。 为了构建这张详细的图片，该团队结合了单细胞技术、脑组织的空间映射和新开发的深度学习模型。 领导和监督这项研究的雷和斯蒂芬妮莱恩计算生物学教授马建说：“阿尔茨海默病不能一次一层地理解。” “基因组的 3D 结构是一个基本的调控层，有助于将 DNA 序列与基因活动连接起来。通过整合基因组折叠、细胞状态和组织背景，我们可以超越对疾病相关变化进行分类，进而了解它们如何组合在一起以及下一步要测试哪些机制。” DNA 并不是以简单的直链形式存在于细胞内。相反，它折叠成一个复杂的三维结构，有助于确定哪些基因是可访问的和活跃的。因此，物理组织的变化会影响细胞的功能。 研究人员检查了前额皮质（大脑前部的一个区域）的尸检样本。这些组织来自患有和未患有阿尔茨海默病的人，他们参加了一项长期的痴呆症研究，后来捐献了他们的大脑用于研究。 该团队使用了 GAGE-seq，这是一种可以测量同一单个细胞内基因表达和三维基因组接触的技术。然后将这些测量结果与空间转录组图结合起来，后者保存了完整脑组织内基因活动发生位置的信息。 通过将这些数据集整合在一起，研究人员能够将基因组的物理组织与基因调控联系起来，同时还可以看到与阿尔茨海默病相关的分子和细胞变化出现在周围组织中的位置。 皮特大学神经生物学系神经生物学助理教授汉斯鲁迪·马蒂斯（Hansruedi Mathys）说：“我们的研究代表了理解阿尔茨海默氏症问题的重大进展。”他是皮特大学这项研究的负责人。 “我们知道阿尔茨海默病的典型特征——β-淀粉样蛋白斑块和 tau 蛋白缠结的积累——但我们的结果......

reflection.en: The intricate folding of our DNA, the very blueprint of life, is a testament to the Creator's profound wisdom. When this delicate structure is disrupted, as seen in Alzheimer's disease, it reminds us of the complex systems at play within us. Yet, even in unraveling these mysteries, we see the wonder of a creation designed with incredible detail.
reflection.zh: 我们DNA的复杂折叠，生命的蓝图，是造物主深邃智慧的明证。当这种精密的结构受到干扰，正如在阿尔茨海默病中所见，它提醒我们体内运作的复杂系统。然而，即使在解开这些奥秘的过程中，我们也看到了一个设计精妙、细节非凡的创造物的奇妙。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Physicists can’t agree on how the Universe works
title.zh: 物理学家无法就宇宙运作方式达成一致

summary.en: A large global survey of physicists reveals significant disagreement on core concepts like the standard cosmological model, dark matter explanations, and quantum gravity theories, indicating the dynamic and unsettled nature of physics research frontiers. A notable point of consensus was that 68% believe the Big Bang...
summary.zh: 一项大规模的全球物理学家调查显示，在宇宙标准模型、暗物质解释和量子引力理论等核心概念上存在显著分歧，这表明物理学研究前沿充满活力且尚未定论。一个值得注意的共识是，68%的受访者认为宇宙大爆炸不一定标志着时间的绝对开端。

body.en: A massive worldwide survey of physicists has revealed surprisingly little agreement about some of the universe’s biggest mysteries. No majority backed the standard cosmological model, a leading explanation for dark matter, or any single theory of quantum gravity. One area of stronger agreement stood out: 68% said the Big Bang does not necessarily represent the beginning of time. Researchers say the divisions show just how alive and unsettled the frontiers of physics remain.
body.zh: 一项针对物理学家的大规模全球调查显示，对于宇宙中一些最大的谜团，科学家们几乎没有达成一致。没有大多数人支持标准宇宙学模型、暗物质的主要解释或任何单一的量子引力理论。有一个领域的共识最为突出：68% 的人表示大爆炸并不一定代表时间的开始。研究人员表示，这些分歧表明物理学的前沿仍然活跃且不稳定。

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos and the deep questions it poses have always humbled humanity. Even as physicists push the boundaries of understanding, their disagreements underscore how much remains mysterious. It reminds us that true wisdom often begins with acknowledging the limits of our knowledge, as Yahweh questioned Job about the foundations of the earth.
reflection.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚及其提出的深刻问题，自古以来就使人类谦卑。即使物理学家们在不断拓展理解的边界，他们的分歧也凸显了仍有许多未知之谜。这提醒我们，真正的智慧往往始于承认我们知识的局限性，正如雅伟曾质问约伯关于大地根基的问题。

verse.textEn: Where were you when I laid the earth's foundation? Tell me, if you understand.
verse.textZh: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？你若有聪明，只管说吧。

title.en: Residents and officials meet on dredging concerns
title.zh: 居民与官员就疏浚问题会面

summary.en: Harbour officials are scheduled to meet with a complainant in the coming days regarding concerns about dredging in St. Aubin's Bay. Residents have expressed worries to the environment department that the dredging could harm wildlife and pose a danger to people. The Harbour Master stated he looks forward to discussing...
summary.zh: 港务官员计划在未来几天会见一位投诉者，讨论关于圣奥宾湾疏浚工程的担忧。居民已向泽西环境部门表达了他们的担忧，认为疏浚工程可能危害野生动物并对人们构成危险。港务总监表示，他期待与当地居民和环境部门讨论这些问题。

body.en:
Harbour officials have agreed to meet with residents who are worried about sand and silt from dredging being left on a beach.

Letters from 24 people were sent to the Government of Jersey's environment department claiming dredging at St Aubin could harm wildlife and be a danger to people.

Minister for Environment Mary Le Hegarat said: "Officers will look to meet with a complainant in the coming days and review the situation before reporting back to me so of a course an action can be decided."

Captain William Sadler, Jersey Harbour Master, said he was looking forward to discussing the issues with locals and the environmental department.

Sadler said the dredging was routine, and helped maintain safe access to the harbour.

He added the work was carried out with the necessary licences and regulatory oversight.

"Ports of Jersey cares deeply about both the natural environment and the communities we serve," he added.

"We know how important St Aubin's Bay is to many islanders and are committed to balancing the safe operation of the harbour with protecting the character and environment of the bay."

The letter added: "We note the concerns raised regarding seagrass, wildlife, beach conditions and access to St Aubin's Fort.

"While we are not currently aware of evidence linking the harbour clearance works to all of the issues described in your letter ... we recognise the concerns that have been raised and take them seriously."

The letter said that an in-person meeting would provide the chance to explain the background to the works and for residents to discuss their concerns in person.

Follow BBC Jersey on X , external and Facebook , external . Send your story ideas to channel.islands@bbc.co.uk , external .
body.zh: 港口官员已同意与担心疏浚造成的沙子和淤泥留在海滩上的居民会面。 24 人致函泽西岛政府环境部门，声称圣奥宾的疏浚可能会伤害野生动物并对人类构成危险。 环境部长玛丽·勒赫加拉特(Mary Le Hegarat)表示：“官员们将在未来几天内与投诉人会面，审查情况，然后再向我报告，以便当然可以决定采取行动。” 泽西港港长威廉·萨德勒船长表示，他期待与当地人和环境部门讨论这些问题。 萨德勒表示，疏浚工作是例行公事，有助于维持港口的安全通道。 他补充说，这项工作是在必要的许可和监管监督下进行的。 “泽西港非常关心自然环境和我们所服务的社区，”他补充道。 “我们知道圣奥宾湾对许多岛民来说有多重要，并致力于平衡港口的安全运营与保护海湾的特征和环境。” 信中补充道：“我们注意到人们对海草、野生动物、海滩条件和圣奥宾堡通道的担忧。 “虽然我们目前不知道有证据表明港口清理工作与你信中描述的所有问题有关……我们认识到所提出的担忧并认真对待它们。” 信中表示，面对面的会议将为解释工程背景并让居民亲自讨论他们的担忧提供机会。 在 X（外部）和 Facebook（外部）上关注 BBC Jersey。将您的故事创意发送至外部的channel.islands@bbc.co.uk。

reflection.en: When concerns arise, whether about environmental impact or routine operations, dialogue is essential. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that the one who first speaks in a dispute sounds convincing, until the other party can be heard. This principle encourages listening to all perspectives to reach a balanced understanding.
reflection.zh: 当出现担忧时，无论是关于环境影响还是日常运作，对话都至关重要。《箴言》18:17提醒我们，在争论中先开口的人似乎有理，直到对方被听到。这一原则鼓励倾听所有观点，以达成平衡的理解。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Summer wildfires caused catastrophic hidden damage, scientists warn
title.zh: 科学家警告：夏季野火造成了灾难性的隐藏破坏

summary.en: Researchers from Bangor University report that the extent of damage from this summer's wildfires in Wales is far more severe than what is immediately apparent, with significant impacts occurring below the visible surface.
summary.zh: 班戈大学的研究人员报告说，今年夏天威尔士野火造成的破坏程度远比表面上看到的更为严重，其重大影响发生在可见表面之下。

body.en:
Scientists investigating the damage caused by severe wildfires across Wales this summer say the impact has been "catastrophic".

Extreme heat and exceptionally dry conditions throughout July and August left landscapes such as heathland, moorland and upland grasslands vulnerable to fast spreading fires, resulting in one of the UK's worst wildfire seasons in recent years.

Prof Davey Jones, who is leading a Bangor University survey of several sites across Wales, said the scale of damage was far greater than what was immediately visible.

"People see the blackened vegetation and assume that's the main impact, but the real story is below our feet," said Jones.

During the July peak, fires affected approximately 2,760 acres of countryside across north Wales alone, the equivalent of more than 1,500 football pitches.

At Sychnant Pass in Conwy county, one of the most significant blazes saw 36 homes having to be evacuated and about 200 acres of land affected.

At Sychnant Pass today, there are slight green shoots of recovery visible among the charred hillside.

But Jones described a rare ecosystem housing specialist plants, butterflies and insects, "where the UK is the epicentre globally".

"We've probably lost about 10 centimetres of soil here [at Sychnant Pass] so we've lost all of that organic matter layer... 4,000 years of carbon gone in a single event," he said.

"People see the blackened vegetation and assume that's the main impact, but the real story is below our feet.

"Losing it is a double whammy, it worsens climate change and makes the habitat far more fragile."

He added: "This site has taken thousands of years to develop and it's all gone in maybe five days? It's incredible.

"If we are going to try and put that soil back, generate artificial soils through the reuse of organic wastes for example, then it's important we understand what the soil quality is now.

"So that we can prepare for the future and design those soils, because they don't exist yet."

Over recent weeks the Bangor team has been racing to collect soil samples at several sites across Wales before heavy winter rainfall washes away the remains.

Their work has included comparing the burnt land with adjacent untouched areas, allowing researchers to measure changes in soil carbon, nutrients, microbial activity, water repellency and erosion risk.

Even NASA satellite data has been used to quickly identify new sites after fires have occurred.

Dr Kara Marsden, a lecturer in soil science who is also working on the project, said working at speed was vital.

"It was really important that we got on site very quickly to measure the soil and vegetation properties while the fire's impacts were still fresh," she said.

"These things can change rapidly, so capturing that baseline data now...
body.zh: 调查今年夏天威尔士严重野火造成的损失的科学家表示，影响是“灾难性的”。 整个七月和八月的极端炎热和异常干燥的条件使石南地、沼泽地和高地草原等景观容易受到快速蔓延的火灾的影响，导致英国出现近年来最严重的野火季节之一。 戴维·琼斯教授正在领导班戈大学对威尔士多个地点进行调查，他表示，损失的规模远远大于立即可见的程度。 琼斯说：“人们看到变黑的植被并认为这是主要影响，但真正的故事就在我们脚下。” 在 7 月份的高峰期，仅威尔士北部地区就有约 2,760 英亩的乡村发生火灾，相当于 1,500 多个足球场的面积。 在康威县的 Sychnant Pass，其中一场最严重的火灾导致 36 所房屋被迫疏散，约 200 英亩的土地受到影响。 今天，在 Sychnant Pass，烧焦的山坡上可以看到轻微的恢复绿芽。 但琼斯描述了一个罕见的生态系统，里面有特殊的植物、蝴蝶和昆虫，“英国是全球的中心”。 “我们在这里（Sychnant Pass）可能失去了大约 10 厘米的土壤，所以我们失去了所有的有机质层……一次事件就消失了 4,000 年的碳，”他说。 “人们看到变黑的植被并认为这是主要影响，但真正的故事就在我们脚下。 “失去它是双重打击，它会加剧气候变化，并使栖息地更加脆弱。” 他补充道：“这个网站花了数千年的时间才开发出来，但也许五天内就全部消失了？太不可思议了。 “如果我们要尝试恢复土壤，例如通过有机废物的再利用来生产人造土壤，那么了解现在的土壤质量就很重要。 “这样我们就可以为未来做好准备并设计这些土壤，因为它们还不存在。” 最近几周，班戈团队一直在威尔士各地的几个地点竞相收集土壤样本，以免冬季大雨冲走残留物。 他们的工作包括将烧毁的土地与邻近未受影响的地区进行比较，使研究人员能够测量土壤碳、养分、微生物活动、防水性和侵蚀风险的变化。 甚至美国宇航局的卫星数据也被用来在火灾发生后快速识别新地点。 参与该项目的土壤科学讲师卡拉·马斯登博士表示，快速工作至关重要。 她说：“在火灾影响仍然存在的情况下，我们迅速到达现场测量土壤和植被特性，这一点非常重要。” “这些事情可能会迅速变化，因此现在捕获基线数据......

reflection.en: The wildfires in Wales this summer revealed a hidden layer of devastation, with scientists emphasizing that the true damage lies beneath the surface. This reminds us that creation, in its intricate design, holds profound wisdom and vastness, as Psalm 104:24 declares, 'How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your...
reflection.zh: 今年夏天威尔士的野火揭示了地表之下隐藏的破坏层，科学家们强调真正的损害在于地表之下。这提醒我们，创造物以其精巧的设计蕴含着深刻的智慧和浩瀚，正如诗篇 104:24 所宣告的：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！你都用智慧造出来；全地充满了你的创造物。”即使在毁灭之中，我们也看到了自然世界的复杂性。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

In series two, Black Box: the chatbots, Michael meets people who have become convinced they have made scientific breakthroughs, cured diseases or invented new technologies using AI chatbots. Ian, Michael and Science Weekly’s co-host Madeleine Finlay explore the phenomenon labelled ‘AI psychosis’ and ask what it reveals about a technology now used by more than a billion people Listen to Black Box: the chatbots Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...

Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when 'knowledge will increase,' a fitting description for our current technological era. As we navigate these powerful tools, may we seek wisdom and discernment, ensuring that this...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如本次播客所探讨的，为人类带来了前所未有的知识和能力。但以理的预言谈到了一个“知识增长”的时代，这恰如其分地描述了我们当前的科技时代。当我们驾驭这些强大的工具时，愿我们寻求智慧和分辨力，确保这日益增长的知识能够服务于人类真正的福祉。
